# Sockets

Address families, socket types and options, and the calls that open, bind and connect sockets.

<h2 id="af-inet"><code>AF_INET</code></h2>

```rux
pub const AF_INET: int32 = 2;
```

`AF_INET`: the IPv4 address family.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Socket.rux#L41)


<h2 id="sock-stream"><code>SOCK_STREAM</code></h2>

```rux
pub const SOCK_STREAM: int32 = 1;
```

`SOCK_STREAM`: a connected byte stream.

<h2 id="sock-cloexec"><code>SOCK_CLOEXEC</code></h2>

```rux

```

`SOCK_CLOEXEC`: close the socket when the process starts another program.

<h2 id="so-reuseaddr"><code>SO_REUSEADDR</code></h2>

```rux
pub const SO_REUSEADDR: int32 = 2;
```

`SO_REUSEADDR`: let a listening address be bound again while old connections to it wind down.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Socket.rux#L71)

<h2 id="so-rcvtimeo"><code>SO_RCVTIMEO</code></h2>


`SO_RCVTIMEO`: how long a receive waits.

<h2 id="so-sndtimeo"><code>SO_SNDTIMEO</code></h2>

<h2 id="socket"><code>Socket</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Socket(
    domain: int32,
    kind: int32,
    protocol: int32
) -> int64
```

Opens a socket.

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/socket.2.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/socket.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Socket.rux#L115)

**Parameters**

| Name       | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `domain`   | `int32` | the address family, such as [`AF_INET`](/docs/api/linux/socket#af-inet)                                                                           |
| `kind`     | `int32` | the socket type, such as [`SOCK_STREAM`](/docs/api/linux/socket#sock-stream), combined with [`SOCK_CLOEXEC`](/docs/api/linux/socket#sock-cloexec) |
| `protocol` | `int32` | the protocol, or zero for the family's default                                                                                                    |

**Returns**: the new descriptor, or a negative error number

<h2 id="connect"><code>Connect</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Connect(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    address: *opaque,
    length: uint32
) -> int64
```

Connects a socket to `address`, waiting for a stream connection to be made.

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/connect.2.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/connect.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Socket.rux#L126)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                 |
| --------- | ---------------- | --------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                  |
| `address` | `*opaque`        | the address, a `sockaddr`   |
| `length`  | `uint32`         | the address's size in bytes |

**Returns**: zero, or a negative error number

<h2 id="listen"><code>Listen</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Listen(fd: FileDescriptor, backlog: int32) -> int64
```

Makes a bound stream socket accept connections.

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/listen.2.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/listen.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Socket.rux#L147)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                  |
| --------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                                   |
| `backlog` | `int32`          | how many connections may wait to be accepted |

**Returns**: zero, or a negative error number

<h2 id="accept4"><code>Accept4</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Accept4(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    address: *var opaque,
    length: *var uint32,
    flags: int32
) -> int64
```

Accepts a waiting connection as a new socket.

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/accept4.2.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/accept4.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Socket.rux#L159)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                                                             |
| --------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the listening socket                                                                    |
| `address` | `*var opaque`    | receives the peer's address, or null                                                    |
| `length`  | `*var uint32`    | the address buffer's size, then the address's, or null                                  |
| `flags`   | `int32`          | flags for the new socket, such as [`SOCK_CLOEXEC`](/docs/api/linux/socket#sock-cloexec) |

**Returns**: the new descriptor, or a negative error number

<h2 id="sendto"><code>SendTo</code></h2>

```rux
pub func SendTo(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    buffer: *opaque,
    count: uint,
    flags: int32,
    address: *opaque,
    length: uint32
) -> int64
```

Sends bytes on a socket, to `address` when it is not connected.

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/sendto.2.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/sendto.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Socket.rux#L173)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                                         |
| --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                                                          |
| `buffer`  | `*opaque`        | the bytes                                                           |
| `count`   | `uint`           | how many                                                            |
| `flags`   | `int32`          | flags such as [`MSG_NOSIGNAL`](/docs/api/linux/socket#msg-nosignal) |
| `address` | `*opaque`        | the destination, or null for a connected socket                     |
| `length`  | `uint32`         | the destination's size                                              |

**Returns**: the bytes sent, or a negative error number

<h2 id="receivefrom"><code>ReceiveFrom</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ReceiveFrom(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    buffer: *var opaque,
    count: uint,
    flags: int32,
    address: *var opaque,
    length: *var uint32
) -> int64
```

Receives bytes from a socket, and where they came from.

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/recvfrom.2.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/recvfrom.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Socket.rux#L187)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                            |
| --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                                             |
| `buffer`  | `*var opaque`    | receives the bytes                                     |
| `count`   | `uint`           | how many fit                                           |
| `flags`   | `int32`          | flags, or zero                                         |
| `address` | `*var opaque`    | receives the sender's address, or null                 |
| `length`  | `*var uint32`    | the address buffer's size, then the address's, or null |

**Returns**: the bytes received, zero once a stream's peer closed it, or a negative error number

<h2 id="shutdown"><code>Shutdown</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Shutdown(fd: FileDescriptor, how: int32) -> int64
```

Ends one or both directions of a connection.
